meta.description: Firefly: The Game – Alliance Alert cards

allianceAlerts.name: Persons of Interest
allianceAlerts.detail: When you Botch a Job, Disgruntle your entire Crew.
allianceAlerts.systemWideText: :::SYSTEM WIDE:::\nAuthority granted for increased surveillance and detention of any suspicious persons. Probable cause protocols suspended.

allianceAlerts.name: Alliance Audit
allianceAlerts.detail: Each time a player completes a Job, place this card on that Contact's deck. Players may not take a Deal Action with that Contact until this card moves.

allianceAlerts.name: Rapid Response
allianceAlerts.detail: When a player moves an Alliance Ship, they may move it one extra Sector.\nDoes not apply to the "Alliance Contact" Nav Card.

allianceAlerts.name: Criminal Sighting
allianceAlerts.detail: Each time a player Hires a Wanted Crew, place this card on that Supply Deck. Players may not take a Buy Action at this location until this card moves.

allianceAlerts.name: Privledge Suspension
allianceAlerts.detail: Players do not count as Solid with Harken while this card is in play.
allianceAlerts.systemWideText: :::SYSTEM WIDE:::\nDispersion of work contracts to independent contractors is suspended until further notice, pending investigation into new regulatoy framework.

allianceAlerts.name: Incarceration Order
allianceAlerts.detail: When resolving Alliance Contact, you may remove on of your Wanted Crew from Play instead of paying one Warrant's fine.

allianceAlerts.name: White Sun Commerce
allianceAlerts.detail: If you have any Warrants, you may not Buy at Osiris or Persephone.
allianceAlerts.systemWideText: :::SYSTEM WIDE:::\nAll financial transactions are not subject to three-level Cortex authentication.

allianceAlerts.name: Criminal Activity
allianceAlerts.detail: +1 Misbehave when you Work an Illegal Job while you have any Warrants.

allianceAlerts.name: Background Checks
allianceAlerts.detail: If you have any Warrants when you roll for Wanted Crew, you must roll higher than your number of Warrants for each Crew to Dodge Capture.
allianceAlerts.systemWideText: :::SYSTEM WIDE:::\nAll imported shipments are subject to increased Customs Inspection and Scrutiny.

allianceAlerts.name: Enhanced Inspection
allianceAlerts.detail: You may not Sell Cargo to Contacts.
